description: This file manages the installation and staging of runtime dependencies for bundled plugins in a Node.js environment. It includes functions for reading/writing JSON, handling directories, dependency resolution, and orchestrating plugin dependency installation with retries.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from the given path.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a value as JSON and writes it to a file.

methods.name: removePathIfExists
methods.description: Removes a file or directory at the specified path if it exists.

methods.name: makeTempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with a specified prefix.

methods.name: sanitizeTempPrefixSegment
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be used as a prefix segment in temp directory names.

methods.name: replaceDir
methods.description: Replaces a target directory with a source directory, copying if needed.

methods.name: dependencyNodeModulesPath
methods.description: Constructs a path to a dependency in node_modules.

methods.name: readInstalledDependencyVersion
methods.description: Reads the version of an installed dependency from its package.json.

methods.name: dependencyVersionSatisfied
methods.description: Checks if an installed dependency version satisfies a given semver spec.

methods.name: collectInstalledRuntimeClosure
methods.description: Collects all dependencies in the runtime closure that satisfy version specs.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDirs
methods.description: Lists directories of bundled plugins with package.json in the dist/extensions folder.

methods.name: hasRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Checks if a package.json has dependencies or optionalDependencies.

methods.name: shouldStageRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Determines if runtime dependencies should be staged based on package.json flags.

methods.name: sanitizeBundledManifestForRuntimeInstall
methods.description: Removes openclaw peer, dev dependencies from a plugin's package.json.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeDepsStampPath
methods.description: Gets the path to the runtime deps stamp file for a plugin.

methods.name: createRuntimeDepsFingerprint
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash fingerprint of the package.json.

methods.name: readRuntimeDepsStamp
methods.description: Reads the runtime deps stamp JSON file.

methods.name: stageInstalledRootRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Stages runtime dependencies from the root node_modules into the plugin directory.

methods.name: installPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Installs runtime dependencies for a plugin, either by staging existing or running npm install.

methods.name: installPluginRuntimeDepsWithRetries
methods.description: Attempts to install dependencies with retries.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Main exported function to stage runtime dependencies for all bundled plugins.
